item.title: Scientists hunt for origins of the mysterious 'sun goddess' particle
item.description: Scientists have used a novel new approach to discover the potential origins of the sun goddess particle Amaterasu, the second most energetic cosmic ray ever to be detected striking Earth.

item.description: With The Mandalorian & Grogu movie release getting ever closer, Lego has just announced five tie-in sets.

item.description: SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets carrying Starlink satellites launched on Feb. 14 and Feb. 16, 2026 from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, respectively.

item.title: How astronomers are unveiling the 'skeleton' of the universe
item.description: Faint structures play a crucial role in cosmic development, and scientists are only just beginning to grasp their full extent and role in shaping the universe.

item.title: Astronomers discover chemicals that could seed life in the core of a developing star
item.description: An organic molecule called methanimine was found scattered throughout a dense clump of gas and dust 554 light-years away.

item.title: Why don't more Tatooine-like exoplanets exist in our Milky Way galaxy? Astronomers might have an answer
item.description: Astronomers may finally understand why planets orbiting two suns, the real-world equivalents of the "Star Wars" planet Tatooine, are so scarce in our galaxy — and it has to do with general relativity.

item.title: Annular solar eclipse turns the sun into a dramatic 'ring of fire' today! Here's what you need to know
